> **This repository does not accept unsolicited pull requests.** A pull request opened without an invitation is closed automatically, and nothing you write below will change that. It is not a judgement on the code.
>
> **Send the report instead.** A reproducible bug, a compatibility regression, or a documentation error goes in an [issue](https://github.com/dvmkit/sdk/issues/new/choose); an idea, a design question, or an argument about direction goes in a [discussion](https://github.com/dvmkit/sdk/discussions). We would rather have your reproduction than your patch, and [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/dvmkit/sdk/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) explains why.
>
> Delete this block if you are a maintainer, or if a maintainer invited this pull request on a specific issue.

## Issue

Closes #

## What changes for builders

The user-visible effect, plus any public API, wire, payment, or migration impact.

## Verification

The commands you actually ran after your final edit, and their result.

## Checklist

- [ ] A maintainer invited this change on the linked issue, or I am a maintainer.
- [ ] Scope matches the linked issue and excludes unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behaviour, or this change alters no behaviour.
- [ ] The public API surface is unchanged, or `npm run check:api` was re-baselined deliberately and the change is called out above.
- [ ] Documentation is updated, or none was affected.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, real payment values, or customer data in the diff, the tests, or the fixtures.
